product.title: Love You - Floral Mini Gift Set
product.description: Sweet kisses and soothing showers await with our Raspberry & Rosehip Natural Lip Balm, paired with the indulgent Love You Shower Steamer duo. The lip balm nourishes with a fruity-sweet blend enriched by rosehip for soft, kissable lips, while the steamers release a floral, romantic aroma to transform your shower into a self-care sanctuary. A thoughtful gift or personal treat, this set is the perfect way to relax, refresh, and indulge. What is a shower steamer and how do I use it? Similar to a bath bomb, shower steamers are activated by water. They add a touch of luxury to your shower experience, can improve your mood or clear your sinuses. Simply place your shower steamer on a shelf or shower caddy, on a soap dish or on the floor out of the water stream, where hot shower spray can activate the shower steamer and release the aroma of its essential oils into the air. Placing your steamer up off the floor will improve the aroma experience and help your shower steamer to last longer. How many showers will my steamer last? Reposition your shower steamer if it is getting too wet too quickly or is placed between you and an air vent. It is recommended to position your steamer up off the floor if possible. Depending on placement, shower duration and how intense you desire the scent to be, your steamer may last 2+ showers.
